V. 31.
But I ſuffer him thus to aſſault me,
1. Becauſe it is the Father's Commiſſion to me (ch. x. 18.)
2. To convince the World of my Love to the Father, in being obedient unto death, Phil. ii. 8. Ar•ſe, let us go hence—Into the City, to the Paſſover.
All that has been related from ch. xiii. 31. was done and ſaid on Thurſday without the City, But what follows in the xv.xvi. and xviith Chapters, was ſaid in the City, on the very Evening of the Paſſover, juſt before He went over the Brook Ced•on.
